value.title: Launch settings and parameters on a role (workstream 007 s01)
value.summary: A role records the harness, model and effort its holder runs on (the existing `default_seat`) and the parameters it needs filled at start, each required or optional. Filling them refuses an unknown name and names every missing required one.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: A role records the harness, model and effort its holder runs on (the existing `default_seat`) and the parameters it needs filled at start, each required or optional. Filling them refuses an unknown name and names every missing required one.

sections.name: goals
value: A role says how to launch its holder and what it needs to start.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Starting a seat (plan 242) and the first turn (plan 241).

value.claim: `pij directory add` and `edit` take `--param <name>` (required) and `--param <name>:optional`, repeatable, written to a new `parameters` section (`{name, need}`), with the existing `--harness`, `--model` and `--effort` in `default_seat`. A parameter name takes the instance-key grammar; a repeated name refuses.

`role::fill_parameters(document, sets)` returns the filled values in declaration order; it refuses `E-RS-PARAM-UNKNOWN` for a `--set` the role does not declare (listing the declared ones) and `E-RS-PARAM-MISSING` naming every required one left out. A value is one line.
The role schema carries `parameters`; `pij directory add --help` and the API doc describe it.

value.title: Launch settings and parameters on a role (workstream 007 s01)

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: Role documents: crates/daemon/src/community/role.rs and the add/edit flag lists in crates/daemon/src/http/directory.rs. `default_seat` already holds harness, model and effort.

value.risk: A role's parameters drift from its text's placeholders.
value.mitigation: Plan 241 fills `<name>` placeholders and leaves unknown ones as they are.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Cost: on demand only: add and edit are the writer's usual commit; filling is in-process. No loop, poll or timer.
No permission rule changes (PRD 003); no daemon enforcement of a type's rules; no existing JSON field removed or renamed.
Builds nice-19 through `just shared-build`, one at a time.
